scenario.name: fake_data_attack
scenario.title: Security test · fake navigation data
scenario.description: Like the 2020 Berlin case (99 phones in a handcart faked a jam on Google Maps), phantom probe reports claim a long queue on J2's north approach during the peak. Does a probe-based controller get fooled, and does the cross-check against loop detectors catch it?
scenario.question: Does fake probe data make a controller waste green time, and is it detected?

controller.name: max_pressure_probe
controller.label: Max-pressure (navigation probes, no defense)
controller.description: Max-pressure fed only by navigation-app probe reports, trusted blindly. Start the fake-data attack to see it fooled; max_pressure with source=probe, defense=True is the fix.
